name: SRVZr
summary: SRVZr is an AI-powered business app that helps run service, rental, event, menu/POS, stint, and robot-based businesses on autopilot. It gives businesses built-in tools for quotes, invoices, forms, scheduling, contracts, logs, inventory, menus, events, work orders, terminals, and customer management. Users can describe their business, and SRVZr helps customize the right toolkit so they can manage operations more easily and focus on their work.
